caption:
Costa Rica’s interior ridges rarely offer a compromise. When mountain biking in Costa Rica, you quickly learn that the shortest path between two valleys is often a straight line directly over the crest. The grass is thick with morning dew, the air is thin and cool, and the grade often demands that you walk your bike to keep moving forward. There is no shame in the hike-a-bike; it is simply part of the rhythm of the terrain. Up here, the silence is wide, broken only by the click of a freehub and your own breath. Which climb has taught you to slow down?
